# Module `lune_ui_core::widgets`

[API reference](../INDEX.md) / parent [`lune_ui_core`](index.md)

Controls, styled after the house look's overrides of the Fluent theme (`DarkTheme.axaml`). Every
widget is generic over the app's hit type and reads its tokens from the painter's [`Theme`](theme.md#struct.Theme).

Source: `crates/lune-ui-core/src/widgets/mod.rs:1`
